NAME: DSU verification plan
details: Block 2: dsu_top with three mac_unit, the decoder and the interlock. Custom-0 instructions in the core's EX stage. Source: GARUDA-DSU-SPEC-001 and its numeric contract. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. The reference model already exists and is independent of the RTL: tools/golden/DSU_Golden.py. The unit bench drives one instruction at a time and never flushes, so everything that depends on the pipeline is checked with programs on the core.
